name: NeRF-Art
definition: A text-guided NeRF stylization approach that manipulates the style of a pre-trained NeRF model with a simple text prompt, altering both appearance and geometry without mesh guidance.
summary: NeRF-Art is a text-guided method that stylizes pre-trained NeRFs by simultaneously altering appearance and 3D geometry without mesh guidance, using global-local contrastive learning for style adherence.
